archetype: ARCHETYPE 4: SWISS & HIGH-CONTRAST (Authority, Clarity, Truth) - Adapted for Technical Dark Mode

rules: Use JetBrains Mono for all IP addresses, ONU power levels, MAC addresses, connection times, and amounts to ensure tabular alignment.
H1 must not exceed text-4xl on desktop for this dense dashboard.

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Grid Borders (The 'Technical' Look). Use border-collapse styles or consistent 1px borders for dense data tables.
visual_enhancers.borders: Sharp edges or subtle roundness (max 8px). Use Tailwind's 'rounded-md' or 'rounded-none'.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Only for sticky top header. Use 'backdrop-blur-xl bg-background/80 border-b border-border'. DO NOT use fully transparent backgrounds anywhere content scrolls underneath.
visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle noise overlay on the main dashboard background to kill digital flatness (optional).

layouts.app_structure: Left fixed sidebar for 15+ navigation modules + Top sticky header (User profile, quick actions) + Main content area. Sidebar MUST be clearly segmented.
layouts.dashboard_grid: The 'Bento' Grid Protocol - Mode B (High Density). Base Grid: grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-4 or 12-col system. Tight gaps (gap-4 or gap-6).
layouts.alignment: Left-align dense data, tables, and forms for scannability. Place the most important KPIs in the top-left quadrant.

grids.feed_list: col-span-1 row-span-2 (Tall narrow lists like Disconnected Clients > 30min)

motion.interactions: Minimalist micro-interactions. Hover states should have slight lift (-translate-y-1) for cards or subtle background color changes. Explicitly set text color on hover.
motion.transitions: Use specific properties (e.g., transition-colors, transition-transform duration-200). DO NOT use 'transition-all'.

accessibility.testing: All interactive elements and key data points MUST include a 'data-testid' attribute (e.g., data-testid='kpi-active-clients').

3d_libraries.name: react-leaflet or react-map-gl
3d_libraries.usage: 2D/3D map for 'Panel de mapa' to display NAP boxes and client geographical distribution. Use dark mode tile layers.

3d_libraries.name: recharts
3d_libraries.usage: Data visualization for dashboard metrics and Mikrotik real-time consumption.

instructions_to_main_agent: You are building a dense-information ISP operator dashboard (CRM) similar to Wispro.
CRITICAL: You are working in a JavaScript codebase. Create and modify `.jsx`/`.js` files, NOT `.tsx`/`.ts`.

Create the 15+ requested panels logically organized in a Left Sidebar: Dashboard, Clientes, Pagos, WhatsApp, Configuración, Usuarios, OLT, Mikrotik, Planes, Leads, Servicios Extras, Mapa, Desconectados, Tareas.
Cards should NOT have heavy box-shadows. Use a technical flat look with 1px border of border-border. Max border-radius: 8px.
The 'Mapa' panel MUST integrate a map view with markers for NAP boxes and clients.
For the 'Desconectados' panel, include quick-action buttons specifically for WhatsApp messaging.
Ensure 'data-testid' is added to ALL interactive elements (buttons, inputs, tabs).
DO NOT use raw HTML <select> or <input type='date'>. Always use Shadcn components.
The layout must have a sticky top header. Give it a proper backdrop-blur but ensure a semi-solid background (bg-background/80) so content scrolling underneath doesn't make text unreadable.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Avoid the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Do not use generic centered layouts or simplistic gradients.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) ONLY where appropriate, like sticky headers. NEVER on dropdowns or modals.
MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). Add transitions for specific properties.
MUST NOT center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; }).
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters (🤖🧠💡) for icons. Use lucide-react.
NEVER use placeholder URLs (like via.placeholder.com). Use the provided image URLs.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui. Use `sonner` for toast notifications.
